A running header on every page, the blank one included

Chapter one

Chapter one opens on the first page, which Paged.js treats as a right-hand page.

Its second paragraph stays on that page.

So does its third.

Chapter two

Chapter two must open on a right-hand page, so it starts on page 3.

Page 2 is the left-hand page Paged.js inserted, and it says so in print.
